user.title: Calibrate a light
user.description:
Pick a light you trust as the reference, and the light that doesn't match it.

This creates a calibrated light that takes over the target's entity ID, so everything already pointing at that light keeps working and gets corrected output. The real fixture is renamed with a `_raw` suffix.

Calibration starts as soon as this is created.

data.reference_entity: Reference light (the one that looks right)
data.name: Name (optional)

error.same_light: The reference and the light being calibrated have to be two different lights.

create_entry.default:
Calibrated light created.

[Open the calibration screen](/light-calibration) to match it against your reference light. Pause Adaptive Lighting on both lights first, or it will re-adapt them while you work.
